description: Krewss BI answers management questions from the operational data hotel teams already capture in Krewss: how yesterday went, which incidents repeat and in which rooms, who is on duty now, which guest requests were served late and what was asked for, which returning guests are in-house with their stay history, and how the property's Google rating is trending. Every figure drills down to the tasks, SOP submissions or guest requests behind it and links back to the record in Krewss. It is read-only and scoped to the signed-in user's organisation: users sign in with their Krewss credentials and only accounts granted Krewss BI access can connect.

defaultPrompt: Which repeat guests are in house today and what did they ask for during the stay?
Show late department wise requests and who handled them.
